drone_captions: The tugboats look like bath toys from up here.
Every rooftop garden is a little green stamp.
Count the water towers. Lose count. Start over.
The ferry leaves a white zipper across the bay.
Look at the stoop sitters waving like tiny flags.
That crane by the docks is taller than it lets on.
From this high, the traffic hums like a beehive.
The fish market roof shines like a wet coin.
Spot the toad mural painted on the warehouse wall.
The old lighthouse still blinks hello at dusk.
Kites over the park are racing you. Let them win.
The racetrack curls around the lot like a ribbon.
Clotheslines zigzag between the rowhouse backs.
The marina's boats line up like piano keys.
Sunset turns the whole harbor the color of peaches.
